Diana.attackTypeReason: Diana strikes enemies in close quarters using her crescent blade for basic attacks.
Diana.combatRangeReason: Diana spends fights in the middle of enemy teams, using Lunar Rush to dive in and Moonfall to pull targets close.
Diana.pokeReason: Diana is a melee champion who must commit to close-range dive combos to deal meaningful damage.

Gragas.attackTypeReason: Gragas uses his fists and body at close range to perform basic attacks.
Gragas.combatRangeReason: Although Gragas can throw barrels from afar, he must get into melee range to execute his Body Slam and empowered Drunken Rage attacks.
Gragas.pokeReason: As a melee champion, Gragas relies on engaging up close rather than playing as a dedicated long-range poke champion.

Kai'Sa.attackTypeReason: Kai'Sa fires plasma bolts from range using her shoulder pods for basic attacks.
Kai'Sa.combatRangeReason: Kai'Sa operates at short range to land isolated Icathian Rain missiles and stack her Plasma passive effectively.
Kai'Sa.pokeReason: AP Kai'Sa builds leverage her evolved Void Seeker for powerful, spammable long-range poke thanks to its high cooldown refund on champion hits.

Kassadin.attackTypeReason: Kassadin strikes enemies in close proximity with his blade for basic attacks.
Kassadin.combatRangeReason: Kassadin relies on Riftwalk to blink directly onto targets to deal the majority of his burst damage with Force Pulse and Nether Blade.
Kassadin.pokeReason: As a melee champion, Kassadin cannot safely output repeatable ranged damage and must commit to close-range engagements.

Lillia.attackTypeReason: Lillia relies on a short-ranged basic attack with 325 attack range.
Lillia.combatRangeReason: Lillia needs to be in close proximity to weave around targets using her Blooming Blows and Watch Out! Eep! abilities.
Lillia.pokeReason: Her long-range Swirlseed has a high cooldown and low damage, making a long-range poke playstyle ineffective compared to her close-range skirmishing.

Lux.attackTypeReason: Lux fires ranged basic attacks from a distance using her light magic.
Lux.combatRangeReason: Lux is an artillery mage who sits safely in the backline to cast her long-range crowd control and burst spells.
Lux.pokeReason: Her Lucent Singularity and Final Spark provide potent, repeatable long-range damage to soften up targets before teamfights.

Nilah.attackTypeReason: Nilah's basic attacks are categorized as melee, though hitting her first ability temporarily gives her slightly increased melee attack range.
Nilah.combatRangeReason: Nilah must dash directly into melee range to deal her damage, pull enemies with her ultimate, and utilize her basic attack self-healing.
Nilah.pokeReason: Nilah is a close-range skirmisher with virtually no long-range abilities to safely poke enemies before committing to an all-in.

Thresh.attackTypeReason: Thresh performs mid-range basic attacks using his chain scythe, which are classified as ranged attacks in Wild Rift.
Thresh.combatRangeReason: Thresh spends fights in close proximity to enemies to maximize the impact of Flay, The Box, and his Death Sentence recast engage.
Thresh.pokeReason: Thresh's kit revolves around long-cooldown hard engage and crowd control rather than safe, repeatable long-range harassment.

Akali.attackTypeReason: Akali strikes targets in close melee range with her kama, although her passive empowers her next basic attack with extra range.
Akali.combatRangeReason: Akali must dive directly into enemy team fights using her dashes and shroud to execute targets at point-blank range.
Akali.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Akali lacks safe, repeatable long-range abilities to poke enemies down without fully committing to an engagement.

Evelynn.attackTypeReason: Evelynn attacks up close using her lashers with a standard melee basic attack range.
Evelynn.combatRangeReason: Evelynn relies on camouflage to flank and close the distance, needing to be in short range to execute her full burst combo with Whiplash.
Evelynn.pokeReason: Evelynn is a stealth burst assassin whose kit requires committing up close rather than dealing repeatable safe ranged damage.

Katarina.attackTypeReason: Katarina uses melee dagger strikes for her basic attacks.
Katarina.combatRangeReason: Katarina must jump directly into the middle of fights using Shunpo and channel Death Lotus or pick up daggers close to enemies to deal damage.
Katarina.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Katarina relies on all-in commits and resets rather than poking safely from a distance.

Rakan.attackTypeReason: Rakan uses ranged basic attacks by whipping enemies with his cape feathers at a short 300 range.
Rakan.combatRangeReason: Rakan must dash directly into the middle of fights using Grand Entrance and The Quickness to execute his engage and crowd control.
Rakan.pokeReason: Gleaming Quill is Rakan's only long-range skill and serves primarily as a setup for healing rather than a viable poke engine.

Rumble.attackTypeReason: Rumble attacks in melee range using his mech's mechanical arms.
Rumble.combatRangeReason: Rumble spends fights in close quarters to maximize damage with Flamespitter and Overheated basic attacks.
Rumble.pokeReason: Close-range champion. Flamespitter is a short cone applied from on top of the target, so there is no repeatable safe pressure from range to build around.

Vladimir.attackTypeReason: Vladimir fires ranged blood projectiles with his basic attacks.
Vladimir.combatRangeReason: Vladimir is a battlemage who must stay in short-to-medium range to land his Transfusion, Tides of Blood, and Sanguine Pool on enemies.
Vladimir.pokeReason: Vladimir's abilities have relatively short ranges and require him to get close, making him a short-range drain mage rather than a dedicated poke champion.

Ziggs.attackTypeReason: Ziggs uses ranged basic attacks by throwing bombs at his targets from a safe distance.
Ziggs.combatRangeReason: Ziggs is an artillery mage who stays far in the backline, slinging long-range spells constantly without needing to get near enemies.
Ziggs.pokeReason: Ziggs relies heavily on spamming low-cooldown Bouncing Bombs and Hexplosive Minefields from extreme range to poke enemies before a fight.

Aatrox.attackTypeReason: Aatrox strikes targets at close range using his giant greatsword for basic attacks.
Aatrox.combatRangeReason: Aatrox fights in the middle of teamfights to land his Darkin Blade sweetspots and sustain through physical vamp.
Aatrox.pokeReason: As a melee juggernaut, Aatrox lacks safe, repeatable long-range abilities to poke enemies before committing to combat.

Ahri.attackTypeReason: Ahri uses ranged magic attacks from a distance as her basic attack.
Ahri.combatRangeReason: Ahri plays primarily from range using her Orb of Deception and Charm to control and damage enemies before dashing in to execute.

Akshan.attackTypeReason: Akshan's basic attacks are ranged shots from his dual-firing pistol crossbow.

Alistar.attackTypeReason: Alistar strikes enemies at close range using melee basic attacks.

Alistar.pokeReason: Alistar is a melee engage tank with no repeatable long-range abilities to poke enemies safely before fights.

Ambessa.attackTypeReason: Ambessa strikes targets up close using her twin Drakehound blade weapons for her basic attacks.

Amumu.attackTypeReason: Amumu performs basic attacks at close range by headbutting and striking nearby enemies.

Annie.attackTypeReason: Annie uses ranged magic fireballs as her basic attack.

Ashe.attackTypeReason: Ashe uses a bow to deal basic attacks from range.

Nidalee.attackTypeReason: Nidalee uses ranged basic attacks in her default Human form, switching to melee basic attacks when transformed into Cougar form.
Nidalee.combatRangeReason: Although she lands long-range spears to initiate, Nidalee must pounce into melee range in Cougar form to execute targets and finish fights.
Nidalee.pokeReason: Her Human form Javelin Toss is a signature, high-damage long-range skillshot intended to weaken enemies before engaging.
Nidalee.userConfirmed: Owner confirmed 2026-07-28: Nidalee can have poke.

Nocturne.attackTypeReason: Nocturne uses his arm-blades to strike targets at close melee range.
Nocturne.combatRangeReason: Nocturne uses his ultimate to dive targets and spends the duration of fights in melee range basic attacking.
Nocturne.pokeReason: Nocturne is a melee diver who must commit fully to close combat to deal damage rather than poking safely from afar.

Norra.attackTypeReason: Norra is a Yordle mage who attacks enemies from distance using ranged basic attacks.
Norra.combatRangeReason: She casts long-range portals, trinket traps, and skillshot magic bolts while remaining safely in the backline.
Norra.pokeReason: Her kit contains multiple long-range area skillshots like Threads of Homecoming and Portalpalooza that allow repeatable poke from safety.

Nunu & Willump.attackTypeReason: Nunu & Willump strike enemies in close melee range using basic attacks.
Nunu & Willump.combatRangeReason: Nunu & Willump must be right next to enemies to use Consume and maximize the damage and crowd control from their abilities and ultimate.
Nunu & Willump.pokeReason: As a melee engage champion, Nunu & Willump must commit into enemy lines rather than safely poking from range before fights.

Olaf.attackTypeReason: Olaf strikes targets at close range using dual axes for his basic attacks.
Olaf.combatRangeReason: Olaf needs to stay directly next to targets to sustain through basic attacks and continuously deal damage with Reckless Swing.
Olaf.pokeReason: As a melee champion built for extended all-ins, Olaf lacks the kit to execute a viable long-range poke playstyle.

Orianna.attackTypeReason: Orianna fires ranged basic attacks that deal extra magic damage via her passive.
Orianna.combatRangeReason: Orianna stays safely in the backline, manipulating her Ball at range to deal damage and control teamfights.
Orianna.pokeReason: Her low-cooldown Command: Attack and Dissonance allow her to consistently poke enemies from a safe distance.

Ornn.attackTypeReason: Ornn strikes targets up close with his hammer for his basic attacks.
Ornn.combatRangeReason: Ornn is a frontline tank who needs to be in melee range to land Bellows Breath, knock enemies up with Searing Charge, and detonate Brittle procs.
Ornn.pokeReason: Ornn is a melee tank whose abilities require engaging directly into the enemy team rather than poking from a safe distance.

Pantheon.attackTypeReason: Pantheon uses his spear to perform basic attacks in close quarters against nearby targets.
Pantheon.combatRangeReason: Pantheon relies on leaping directly onto enemies with Shield Vault and maintaining close proximity to deal the majority of his damage.
Pantheon.pokeReason: Pantheon is a melee champion whose kit relies on engaging close-range combat rather than sustaining ranged poke.

Poppy.attackTypeReason: Poppy's basic attacks are melee, with her passive occasionally granting a single temporary ranged buckler throw.
Poppy.combatRangeReason: Poppy must be in close quarters to tackle targets into terrain, block dashes, and smash the ground with her hammer.
Poppy.pokeReason: Poppy is a melee tank who lacks repeatable ranged damage and relies on all-in engage.

Pyke.attackTypeReason: Pyke strikes targets up close in melee range using his dagger for basic attacks.
Pyke.combatRangeReason: Pyke relies on dashing into enemies with Phantom Undertow and blinking onto them with his execute ultimate to influence fights up close.
Pyke.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Pyke cannot safely output repeatable poke damage without committing to close-range combat.

Rammus.attackTypeReason: Rammus strikes enemies directly at close range with his basic attacks.
Rammus.combatRangeReason: Rammus must roll directly into the enemy team to taunt targets and deal reflective magic damage at point-blank range.
Rammus.pokeReason: Rammus is a melee tank who lacks safe, repeatable ranged abilities to poke enemies down before a fight.

Rell.attackTypeReason: Rell uses her heavy lance to strike enemies at melee basic attack range.
Rell.combatRangeReason: Rell is an all-in engage tank who dives into the middle of the enemy team with her abilities to pull and crowd-control them.
Rell.pokeReason: Melee engage tank: her damage comes from committing to an engage, not from repeatable pressure at range.
Rell.userConfirmed: Owner corrected 2026-07-28: Rell does NOT get poke (supersedes the earlier confirmation).

Renekton.attackTypeReason: Renekton strikes enemies in close proximity using his crescent blade for basic attacks.
Renekton.combatRangeReason: Renekton is a frontline diver and bruiser who must stay directly next to targets to deal damage and gain sustain.
Renekton.pokeReason: Renekton is a melee champion with no repeatable ranged abilities to poke from a safe distance.

Rengar.attackTypeReason: Rengar strikes targets at close range with his dual daggers for basic attacks.
Rengar.combatRangeReason: Rengar uses his passive leap and ultimate to dive directly on top of targets to deal damage up close.
Rengar.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Rengar must fully commit to close-range combat rather than safely dealing sustained long-range poke.

Riven.attackTypeReason: Riven swings her blade at targets in close range for her basic attacks.
Riven.combatRangeReason: Riven relies on dashing directly onto enemies with her mobility abilities to execute her close-combat combos.
Riven.pokeReason: As a purely melee skirmisher without a low-cooldown ranged spell, Riven cannot poke safely before committing to a fight.

Ryze.attackTypeReason: Ryze executes ranged basic attacks throwing magical energy from distance.
Ryze.combatRangeReason: Ryze is a battle mage who must remain in short-to-medium range to continuously loop his spell combos.
Ryze.pokeReason: Ryze's kit focuses on short-range spell rotations and sustained damage rather than long-range artillery poke.

Samira.attackTypeReason: Samira's default basic attack uses her dual pistols from range, though she switches to sword slashes when targets are in melee proximity.
Samira.combatRangeReason: Samira needs to dive directly into the middle of teamfights to stack her passive and unleash her close-range Ultimate.
Samira.pokeReason: Samira relies on commits and all-in style combos to build her passive rather than repeatedly harassing targets safely from distance.

Senna.attackTypeReason: Senna uses a Relic Cannon to fire high-range basic attacks that gain even more range as she collects Mist.
Senna.combatRangeReason: Senna stays on the backline of teamfights, leveraging her ever-scaling attack range and long-range skillshots to deal damage and support allies.
Senna.pokeReason: Senna frequently pokes with Piercing Darkness and extended basic attacks to siphon Mist and harass enemies from a safe distance.

Seraphine.attackTypeReason: Seraphine attacks from distance using ranged basic attacks that gain even more range through her passive Notes.
Seraphine.combatRangeReason: Seraphine stays safely in the backline to deploy her long-range crowd control and area-of-effect spells during teamfights.
Seraphine.pokeReason: Her high-range High Note and Beat Drop allow her to deal consistent harass damage from long distance before teamfights break out.

Sett.attackTypeReason: Sett delivers basic attacks as alternating left and right melee punches directly at his target.
Sett.combatRangeReason: Sett is a juggernaut who must stay in the center of fights to land punches, pull targets with Facebreaker, and execute his ultimate.
Sett.pokeReason: Sett is a melee champion with no safe, repeatable long-range harassment abilities.

Shen.attackTypeReason: Shen uses basic attacks at close range with his sword.
Shen.combatRangeReason: Shen must dash directly into enemies with Shadow Dash to taunt them and engage in melee combat.
Shen.pokeReason: Shen is a melee champion without any spammable ranged damage abilities to poke enemies.

Shyvana.attackTypeReason: Shyvana attacks enemies at close range with melee strikes in both her human and dragon forms.
Shyvana.combatRangeReason: Shyvana must dive into the enemy team with her ultimate to deal sustained damage using Burnout and basic attacks.
Shyvana.pokeReason: Her long-range damage is tied to Flame Breath in Dragon Form, which relies on Fury and cannot be spammed for pre-fight poke.

Singed.attackTypeReason: Singed strikes targets up close with melee basic attacks.
Singed.combatRangeReason: Singed needs to be directly on top of or in front of enemies to damage them with Poison Trail and displace them with Fling.
Singed.pokeReason: Singed is a melee champion whose primary damage comes from close-range area-of-effect poison rather than long-range poke.

Sion.attackTypeReason: Sion strikes enemies at close range using his axe for basic attacks.
Sion.combatRangeReason: Sion operates as a frontline tank who needs to be in the middle of fights to charge his Decimating Smash and detonate Soul Furnace.
Sion.pokeReason: As a melee champion, Sion cannot execute a true poke playstyle without entering close combat.

Sivir.attackTypeReason: Sivir throws her crossblade to perform basic attacks at a distance.
Sivir.combatRangeReason: Sivir stays at a safe distance behind her frontline, utilizing her ranged attacks and bouncing abilities to hit enemies.
Sivir.pokeReason: Sivir can utilize a lethality or caster-oriented build focused on spamming her Boomerang Blade to poke down enemies from long range.

Skarner.attackTypeReason: Skarner uses close-range basic attacks to deal physical damage to nearby targets.
Skarner.combatRangeReason: Skarner is a frontline tank and juggernaut who must engage at close range to deal damage and crowd control targets.
Skarner.pokeReason: Skarner is a melee champion without safe, repeatable long-range harassment tools.

Smolder.attackTypeReason: Smolder utilizes ranged basic attacks to strike enemies from a safe distance.
Smolder.combatRangeReason: Smolder functions as a backline marksman and ability caster, maintaining distance while scaling his Dragon Practice stacks.
Smolder.pokeReason: Smolder heavily relies on long-range poke with Achooo! (W) and his stack-empowered Super Scorcher Breath (Q) to wear down enemies before fights.

Sona.attackTypeReason: Sona uses ranged basic attacks to strike enemies from a distance.
Sona.combatRangeReason: As a backline enchanter support, Sona stays safely behind frontline allies to provide teamwide buffs, healing, and ranged poke.
Sona.pokeReason: Her Hymn of Valor auto-targets nearby enemies on a short cooldown, allowing safe and consistent poke from range.

Soraka.attackTypeReason: Soraka fires ranged star projectiles for her basic attacks.
Soraka.combatRangeReason: Soraka positions in the backline to safely heal allies and cast control spells from range.
Soraka.pokeReason: Although Starcall provides short-cooldown harass in lane, Soraka scales as an enchanter healer rather than a dedicated poke damage dealer.

Swain.attackTypeReason: Swain uses ranged basic attacks that deal magic-infused damage from a distance.
Swain.combatRangeReason: As a battlemage, Swain needs to fight in close proximity to enemies so Demonic Ascension can drain health and Death's Hand can hit with multiple bolts.
Swain.pokeReason: Swain's kit focuses on close-range sustained drain-tanking rather than safe, repeatable long-range harass.

Syndra.attackTypeReason: Syndra attacks enemies from a distance using ranged bolts of dark energy.
Syndra.combatRangeReason: Syndra is a control and burst mage who casts her spells and controls zones from safe long distances.
Syndra.pokeReason: Syndra can consistently harass enemies from safe range using low-cooldown Dark Spheres combined with Force of Will and Scatter the Weak.

Taliyah.attackTypeReason: Taliyah attacks from a distance by hurling rocks with her basic attacks.
Taliyah.combatRangeReason: Taliyah fights from the backline, slinging Q rocks and controlling space with W and E from a safe range.
Taliyah.pokeReason: Threaded Volley is a low-cooldown, long-range skillshot perfectly suited for poking enemies before fights.

Talon.attackTypeReason: Talon uses his arm blade to deliver close-range physical basic attacks.
Talon.combatRangeReason: As an assassin, Talon relies on getting directly onto targets to deliver his burst damage and trigger his passive bleed.
Talon.pokeReason: Talon is a melee assassin who must commit to close-range combat to execute enemies rather than poking safely from afar.

Teemo.attackTypeReason: Teemo uses a blowgun to deliver basic attacks from a distance.
Teemo.combatRangeReason: Teemo prefers to stay at range, using his mobility and invisible traps to kite and zone enemies without getting into melee reach.
Teemo.pokeReason: Teemo can deal safe, repeatable damage prior to engagements using Blinding Dart and long-lasting Noxious Trap mushrooms.

Tristana.attackTypeReason: Tristana fires basic attacks from range with her cannon, gaining additional range as she levels up.
Tristana.combatRangeReason: Tristana operates from the safety of the backline, using her high attack range to deal sustained marksman damage.
Tristana.pokeReason: Tristana relies on sustained basic attacks and committing her Explosive Charge to deal damage rather than repeatable, safe poke abilities.

Tryndamere.attackTypeReason: Tryndamere strikes enemies with his sword at close range with melee basic attacks.
Tryndamere.combatRangeReason: Tryndamere spends fights strictly in melee range, using Spinning Slash to dive directly onto enemy champions.
Tryndamere.pokeReason: Tryndamere is a melee champion without repeatable long-range damage abilities, making a poke build completely unviable.

Twisted Fate.attackTypeReason: Twisted Fate attacks from a distance by throwing cards at his targets.
Twisted Fate.combatRangeReason: Twisted Fate spends fights at range, utilizing his Wild Cards and Pick A Card to deal damage and apply crowd control safely.
Twisted Fate.pokeReason: His Wild Cards ability provides low-cooldown, long-range skillshots to chip away at enemy health before committing to fights.

Twitch.attackTypeReason: Twitch fires crossbow bolts from a distance as a traditional ranged marksman.
Twitch.combatRangeReason: Twitch positions on the backline or flanks using stealth, dealing damage from high range especially when Spray and Pray is active.
Twitch.pokeReason: Twitch relies on stealth ambushes, sustained basic attacks, and ultimate area-of-effect damage rather than pre-fight poke.

Urgot.attackTypeReason: Urgot possesses a short-range basic attack that fires projectiles from a distance.
Urgot.combatRangeReason: Urgot must stay directly next to enemies to position his shotgun leg cannons and land Purge and Disdain.
Urgot.pokeReason: Urgot is a close-range juggernaut whose damage heavily relies on proximity leg cannon blasts rather than long-range harass.

Varus.attackTypeReason: Varus uses a bow to perform basic attacks from a long distance.
Varus.combatRangeReason: Varus stays at long range behind his frontline, using Piercing Arrow and Chain of Corruption to deal damage and control fights safely.
Varus.pokeReason: Varus frequently runs a Lethality poke build centered around charging Piercing Arrow from high range to chunk down enemy health before fights.

Vayne.attackTypeReason: Vayne uses a wrist-mounted crossbow to fire ranged basic attacks.
Vayne.combatRangeReason: Vayne relies entirely on basic attacks and short-range Tumbles to deal damage, forcing her to stay in close-to-medium range during teamfights.
Vayne.pokeReason: Vayne has no long-range skillshots or poke tools and must commit to continuous basic attacks within her attack range.

Veigar.attackTypeReason: Veigar strikes targets from a distance with ranged basic magic attacks.
Veigar.combatRangeReason: Veigar positions safely in the backline to cast his spammable abilities and zone enemies with Event Horizon.
Veigar.pokeReason: Veigar can safely harass enemies from range with low-cooldown spells like Baleful Strike and Dark Matter before committing to a burst combo.

Vel'Koz.attackTypeReason: Vel'Koz delivers basic attacks at range using energy beams from his tentacles.
Vel'Koz.combatRangeReason: Vel'Koz functions as an artillery mage who fights from long range behind his frontline using skillshots.
Vel'Koz.pokeReason: Long-range artillery mage: repeatable ability pressure from well outside the fight, which is the definition of poke.
Vel'Koz.userConfirmed: Owner confirmed 2026-07-28: Vel'Koz can get poke.

Vex.attackTypeReason: Vex attacks enemies from range using magical projectiles.
Vex.combatRangeReason: Vex primarily stays at a distance casting Mistral Bolt and Looming Darkness, using her ultimate to dive in only when executing low-health targets or initiating.
Vex.pokeReason: Her Looming Darkness into Mistral Bolt combination provides consistent, safe, and heavy area-of-effect damage from long range.

Vi.attackTypeReason: Vi fights strictly up close using her hextech gauntlets for basic attacks.
Vi.combatRangeReason: Vi is a diver who must dash directly onto enemy champions using Vault Breaker and Assault and Battery to deliver her damage.
Vi.pokeReason: As a melee diver whose primary abilities carry her directly into the fight, Vi has no tools for safe, repeatable long-range poke.

Viego.attackTypeReason: Viego uses his blade to perform basic attacks against enemies in melee range.
Viego.combatRangeReason: Viego must be in close range to land basic attacks, execute abilities, and engage targets effectively.
Viego.pokeReason: As a melee skirmisher, Viego lacks long-range repeatable abilities to poke enemies safely before committing to a fight.

Viktor.attackTypeReason: Viktor fires energy projectiles from a distance with his basic attacks.
Viktor.combatRangeReason: Viktor acts as a control mage who deals heavy area-of-effect damage from a safe distance using Death Ray and Chaos Storm.
Viktor.pokeReason: Viktor's Death Ray allows him to consistently deal high long-range damage before teamfights break out.

Volibear.attackTypeReason: Volibear strikes enemies up close with his claws using melee basic attacks.
Volibear.combatRangeReason: Volibear is a frontline juggernaut who must close the gap and remain in close combat to deal damage and crowd control targets.
Volibear.pokeReason: Volibear is a melee champion who must commit to close combat rather than poking safely from range.

Warwick.attackTypeReason: Warwick strikes enemies at close melee range using his claws for his basic attacks.
Warwick.combatRangeReason: Warwick must be directly on top of enemies to bite, suppress, and continuously attack them.
Warwick.pokeReason: Warwick is a pure melee champion without any spammable ranged damage abilities for poking.

Wukong.attackTypeReason: Wukong strikes targets up close using basic attacks with his staff.
Wukong.combatRangeReason: Wukong relies on dashing directly into enemies with Nimbus Strike and knocking them up in close proximity with Cyclone.
Wukong.pokeReason: Wukong is a melee champion without any long-range spammable poke abilities.

Xayah.attackTypeReason: Xayah uses ranged basic attacks by throwing feathers from a distance.
Xayah.combatRangeReason: As a marksman, Xayah stays in the backline to safely auto-attack, set up feathers, and execute enemies with Bladecaller from distance.
Xayah.pokeReason: Xayah relies on sustained basic attacks and feather placement for teamfight damage rather than repeatable safe poke before fights.

Xin Zhao.attackTypeReason: Xin Zhao attacks targets in close quarters using basic attacks with his spear.
Xin Zhao.combatRangeReason: Xin Zhao is a melee diver who must dash into the enemy team to deal damage and disrupt fights up close.
Xin Zhao.pokeReason: Xin Zhao is a melee diver who must commit to close-range combat and cannot safely poke enemies from a distance.

Yasuo.attackTypeReason: Yasuo uses a katana to perform close-range basic attacks.
Yasuo.combatRangeReason: Yasuo is a mobile skirmisher who must dash into close quarters and stay in melee range to execute his combos and damage.
Yasuo.pokeReason: Yasuo is a melee champion whose only ranged tool is a slow-moving whirlwind that requires stacking up close first.

Yone.attackTypeReason: Yone strikes enemies at close range using basic attacks with his dual swords.
Yone.combatRangeReason: Yone must close the distance using his mobility abilities to deal the vast majority of his damage in melee range.
Yone.pokeReason: Yone is a melee skirmisher who relies on all-in trades and critical strikes rather than ranged poke damage.

Yunara.attackTypeReason: Yunara utilizes ranged basic attacks empowered by her passive and first ability to deal damage from a safe distance.
Yunara.combatRangeReason: Yunara functions as a ranged marksman/mage who stays in the backline to weave basic attacks and cast skillshots.
Yunara.pokeReason: Her primary damage relies on sustained basic attacks and building Unleash stacks rather than non-committal long-range poke spells.

Yuumi.attackTypeReason: Yuumi fires magical ranged projectiles for her basic attacks.
Yuumi.combatRangeReason: Yuumi spends fights attached to an allied champion, casting long-range abilities like Prowling Projectile and Final Chapter safely from a distance.
Yuumi.pokeReason: Her Prowling Projectile allows her to direct a long-range, empowered skillshot repeatedly at enemies before fights start.

Zed.attackTypeReason: Zed strikes enemies at close range using his wrist-mounted blades for basic attacks.
Zed.combatRangeReason: Although Zed can poke with shadow shurikens, he must dive into short range with Living Shadow and Death Mark to assassinate targets.
Zed.pokeReason: As a melee assassin, Zed is not eligible for a dedicated poke build.

Zeri.attackTypeReason: Zeri uses ranged basic attack bursts to damage targets from a safe distance.
Zeri.combatRangeReason: As a traditional marksman, Zeri kites enemies from range while leveraging her high mobility to stay safe.
Zeri.pokeReason: While her Ultrashock Laser can hit from long distance through walls, Zeri relies primarily on sustained basic attack damage during teamfights.

Zilean.attackTypeReason: Zilean attacks targets from a distance with ranged basic attacks.
Zilean.combatRangeReason: Zilean operates as a backline mage and enchanter, casting time bombs and supportive abilities from a safe distance.
Zilean.pokeReason: Time Bomb provides reliable, long-range area damage that can harass enemies safely from a distance.

Zoe.attackTypeReason: Zoe uses ranged basic attacks to strike enemies from a distance.
Zoe.combatRangeReason: Zoe stays far behind the frontline, casting long-range Paddle Stars and Sleepy Trouble Bubbles to deal massive damage from safety.
Zoe.pokeReason: Zoe excels at poking enemies with high-damage, long-range missile recast combos before a teamfight breaks out.

Zyra.attackTypeReason: Zyra hurls thorned projectiles as ranged basic attacks to strike enemies from afar.
Zyra.combatRangeReason: Zyra stays safely in the backline, relying on her long-range plant summons, poke, and crowd control spells to manipulate fights.
Zyra.pokeReason: Zyra can frequently cast Deadly Spines and Grasping Roots from long range to spawn Thorn Spitters that continually harass opponents before fights.
